How it got here

ArgoCD running on the cluster watches the Git repository and continuously makes the cluster match it, so the repository is the record of what is running rather than a description of what someone intended.

  • site · Synced · Healthy
  • reconciled from https://github.com/salgadobreno/homelab-infra at k8s/site
